column1: # The characters' atlases matched by region (PLAN 9.2; names only): stem, what it shows, its colour regions (scripts/riftapart-pair.py regions), each region's material (N=MATERIAL@METRES or N=-).
# characters1 (15 November 2026): the 16 character atlases the props wave flagged, matched by Sonnet agents from region pictures and previews.

# characters2 (15 November 2026): every character atlas the levels load (with the first pass's 16 re-matched): tiles about four times real size, materials whose grain survives at a character's size, normal 2; the same picture matched once.

# metal1 (15 November 2026): Ratchet's and Clank's metal polished steel, chromium and brushed steel (bare metals: no grain, their reflectance their own) in place of the worn paints the player saw as dirty; their eyes' and lenses' regions a glossy clear coat.

# fur1 (15 November 2026): Ratchet's fur (regions 3 to 5) drawn as fur, 12 mm strands, 32 across 15 cm (finer and shorter ones read as nothing at a character's size) (the renderer's shells); his eye (a disc over the pupil, iris and shine) and the lenses a glossy clear coat with a catchlight.
# helmet1 (15 November 2026): Ratchet's helmet (f76fd4297c61a9d7, both palettes) polished steel and chromium, its lights glossy, in place of worn paint and rust.

# characters3 (15 November 2026): every character atlas revised by Sonnet agents (captures/rift/matches/BRIEF-characters3.md): clean metal steel, brushed steel or chromium; fur as fur (the agents' lengths halved to the 6 mm scale that keeps the stripes sharp); eyes and lenses a glossy clear coat with a catchlight, by region or by a disc; copies follow their originals.
# An atlas no frame measured takes its tiles as xN: metres over the 1.5 m a character atlas spans (BRIEF-characters.md).

# characters4 (15 November 2026): every character's metal varied from the whole palette by Sonnet agents (BRIEF-characters4.md): painted plates, worn paint, gunmetal, aged and matte steel, brushed, anodised, brass, bronze, rust; chrome and polished steel only where the design is polished. Ratchet, his helmet and Clank kept as tuned.

# characters5 (15 November 2026): every enemy and NPC atlas opened with its preview by Sonnet agents and fixed where wrong (BRIEF-characters5.md): 30 rows (fur only on fur, skin on bare parts, clean paint for clean armour, cloth for cloth, eyes glossy by disc).
